beat: Waist-chain gift, conditional pressure and private wardrobe change

lines.original: Bantu: I almost forgot miss.... here...
lines.local: Bantu: Arre miss, main toh bhool hi gaya… yeh lijiye!

lines.original: Bantu put his hands inside his shorts pocket and pulled something out.....
lines.local: Bantu ne apni shorts ki pocket mein haath daalkar kuch nikala.

lines.original: Bantu: this is for you miss...a small gift..... she showed her a golden colored waist chain.... it was sleek and simple yet beautiful....
lines.local: Bantu: Aapke liye ek chhota gift miss. Usne sleek, simple aur sundar golden-coloured waist chain dikhayi.

lines.original: Dhika: Bantuuuu... what is this....
lines.local: Dhika: Bantuuu, yeh kya hai?

lines.original: Bantu: its a waist chain miss.... the other day we saw when you were in sexy blouse and petticoat.... and Bobby even tried to pull it....
lines.local: Bantu: Waist chain miss! Us din aap sexy blouse aur petticoat mein thi toh humne dekha tha; Bobby ne toh isse kheenchne ki koshish bhi ki thi.

lines.original: Dhika: ahh Bantuuu.... you can't gift these to your teachers....
lines.local: Dhika: Ahh Bantu! Teachers ko aise gifts nahi de sakte.

lines.original: Bantu: pouting his lips.... but, I thought you were my friend...
lines.local: Bantu honth phulaakar: Lekin mujhe laga aap meri friend hain.

lines.original: Dhika: aww... I am dear... but still... I cannot accept it...
lines.local: Dhika: Aww, hoon dear, par phir bhi yeh accept nahi kar sakti.

lines.original: Bantu: Miss...my mom makes these and sells... when I told her you wore one too... she made this for you... said its a token of thanks for helping us with extra tuitions...
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, meri mom yeh banakar bechti hain. Maine bataya ki aap bhi pehenti hain toh unhone aapke liye banayi. Extra tuition mein help ke thanks ka token hai.

lines.original: Dhika: oh dear... I love helping you guys.... and I don't need anything for it... please take this back....
lines.local: Dhika: Oh dear, mujhe tum logon ki help karna accha lagta hai; uske liye kuch nahi chahiye. Please wapas le lo.

lines.original: Bantu: no miss.. please keep it... I insist, else we will stop coming to the tuition...
lines.local: Bantu: Nahi miss, please rakhiye. Main insist karta hoon, warna hum tuition aana band kar denge.

lines.original: On hearning to his last comment and after few more pestering... she took the chain reluctantly.... she took it and examined its beauty....
lines.local: Uski aakhiri baat aur aur zyada insist karne ke baad Dhika ne reluctantly chain le li aur uski khoobsurati check ki.

lines.original: Bantu: so....miss... wear it... lts see if it fits....
lines.local: Bantu: Toh miss, ise pehenkar dekhiye, fit hoti hai ya nahi!

lines.original: Dhika stood and went into her room and removed the old chain that she was wearing and wore the one Bantu gave... it embraced her hips and looks so good....She came out and showed him too... by slightly raising her T shirt till navel.....
lines.local: Dhika bedroom mein gayi, apni purani waist chain utaarkar nayi pehni. Woh hips par achhi lag rahi thi. Bahar aakar T-shirt ko navel tak thoda utha kar Bantu ko dikhaya.

lines.original: Bantu: looking good miss... Dodgy
lines.local: Bantu chain dekhkar: Acchi lag rahi hai miss… (RAW ka 'Dodgy' mood-marker unclear hai.)

lines.original: Dhika: hehe.....what happened dear ?? why this face...
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, kya hua dear? Aisa chehra kyun?

lines.original: Bantu: Can you remove your T shirt and show naaaaaa miss.... I wanted to see how beautiful you look in it....
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, please T-shirt utaarkar dikha dijiye na! Dekhna hai is chain mein aap kitni beautiful lagti hain.

lines.original: Dhika: aiii.... to see a chain on my hips, I have to remove entire T shirt huh ?
lines.local: Dhika: Aiii, hips ki chain dikhane ke liye poori T-shirt utaarni hogi kya?

lines.original: Bantu: pouting his lips... he only said "yes" but nothing else....
lines.local: Bantu honth phulaakar bas 'haan' bola; aur kuch nahi.

lines.original: Leaving him to sit alone on the sofa...she went into the kitchen....
lines.local: Use akela sofa par bithaakar Dhika kitchen chali gayi.

lines.original: Dhika: Bobby saw me last time and I am sure he said it to Bantu.... that's why he is hell bent in seeing me just in bra.....but how could I............hmmmmmmmmmmmmmm......but poor fellow...... its not fair Bobby saw me and he missed to come that day... hehehe
lines.local: Dhika apne mann mein: Pichhli baar Bobby ne mujhe dekha tha; mujhe yakeen hai usne Bantu ko bataya hoga. Tabhi yeh mujhe sirf bra mein dekhne par ad gaya hai. Par main kaise… hmm… bechara, Bobby ne dekha aur yeh us din aa nahi paaya, unfair hai, hehe!

lines.original: Dhika: wait....let me bring you some water to clear your mind... hehe...
lines.local: Dhika: Ruko, tumhara dimaag thanda karne ke liye paani laati hoon, hehe.

lines.original: While going to the kitchen, she turned to see Bantu sitting very sad not knowing what to do... she giggled to herself and went into the kitchen and brought him a glass of water....
lines.local: Kitchen jaate hue usne palatkar Bantu ko udaas baitha dekha, khud hi giggle ki aur ek glass paani lekar aayi.
